notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator paired with another creature.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it with another creature.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
